memos.skeptic:

TOILETDOG is down 55% from its 30-minute high and 45% over the last 15 minutes, yet the last 15 minutes still show $907k in volume, with 3,747 SOL sold against 3,791 SOL bought and 1,679 sellers versus 1,773 buyers. That is a churning exit, not a healthy pullback. Net flow is nearly flat, so sellers are being absorbed while the price bleeds, which is the signature of holders unloading into retail.

The curve data supports the concern. Bundle share is 1.0 and the top 3 hold 59% of the curve, so a few wallets could still dump the bag. A 112.7 SOL pool is thin relative to 3,700 SOL of sell volume, so any further selling moves price hard. Round-trip fees of 1.4-5.1% are trivial against a 55% drawdown, but a bounce from this level would need to be large to clear them, and the 30-second latency means we'd be buying into a moving book. Skip.
